stand_up.name: Stand-up Comedy
stand_up.definition: A stand-up comedy special or show: one or more comedians performing live sets to an audience (not a sitcom, not a comedy film with actors).

chat_shows.name: Stand-up & Chat Shows
chat_shows.definition: A talk show, late-night show, panel show, chat show or comedy panel built around a host, guests, interviews and conversation (not scripted drama).

cult.name: Cult
cult.definition: A cult film or series: a devoted fan following, midnight-movie status, so-bad-it's-good or genre oddity that outlived its release (not simply a famous blockbuster).

independent.name: Independent
independent.definition: An independent film: made outside the major studios, often low budget, arthouse, festival style or personal in vision (not a studio franchise film).

halloween.name: Halloween
halloween.definition: A spooky title suited to Halloween viewing: horror, ghosts, witches, vampires, haunted places, monsters or Halloween itself (including gentle family spooky titles).

black_stories.name: Black Stories
black_stories.definition: A story centred on Black characters, Black culture, Black history or told by Black creators (not a title that merely has one Black actor in the cast).

lgbtq.name: LGBTQ
lgbtq.definition: A title in which LGBTQ+ characters, relationships or themes are central to the story.

science_nature.name: Science & Nature
science_nature.definition: A documentary or factual series about science, nature, wildlife, space, the planet or how the natural world works (not true crime, not history of people).

sport.name: Sport
sport.definition: A title centred on a sport or sports competition: athletes, teams, matches, training, a sports documentary or a sports drama (not a title where sport is a passing detail).
